correctness.rationale: For any two distinct rows/columns of an order-five Latin square the relative permutation is a derangement of type (2,3) or (5). The normalized backtracking exhausts 1,344 first-row-normalized squares, and the 120 symbol images are proven distinct and exhaustive. Direct subset testing with inclusion-minimality and independent permutation-cycle generation agree on all 161,280 states, length-wise undirected edges (288,000;576,000;1,036,800), the connected-component partitions and the intercalate by component cross-tab. Each union-find edge set lists all legal moves, so the component sizes prove a finite exact result. No infinite-case inference.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The object is invariantly the proper-square single-cycle-switch graph with labelled rows, columns and symbols. Quotienting by isotopy loses fibre components. Column moves are row moves after transposition. Swapping all five positions of a decomposable (2,3) relative permutation is not a single cycle and is excluded.

value.rationale: Connectivity of labelled Latin squares under legitimate proper-state trades determines irreducibility of natural sampling chains. This complete case separates a formerly isolated 17,280-state class from the 144,000-state noncyclic class and shows that allowing 3-cycles and 5-cycles still leaves exactly eight nontrivial chambers, unlike the known connectivity with improper intermediate states. The exact two-scale merge is a motivated boundary result, not merely a table of small counts.
